text_en: After Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples across the Kidron valley to a place where there was a garden, which he and his disciples entered.
text_cn: 耶稣说完了这些话，就和门徒出去，到了克德龙溪的对岸，在那里有一个园子，他和门徒便进去了。

text_en: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, because Jesus often met there with his disciples.
text_cn: 出卖他的犹达斯也知道那地方，因为耶稣同门徒曾屡次在那里聚集。

text_en: So Judas brought a detachment of soldiers together with police from the chief priests and the Pharisees, and they came there with lanterns and torches and weapons.
text_cn: 犹达斯便领了一队兵和由司祭长及法利塞人派来的差役，带着火把、灯笼与武器，来到那里。

text_en: Then Jesus, knowing all that was to happen to him, came forward and asked them, “Whom are you looking for? ”
text_cn: 耶稣既知道要临到他身上的一切事，便上前去问他们说：“你们找谁？”

text_en: They answered, “Jesus of Nazareth. ” Jesus replied, “I am he. ” Judas, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
text_cn: 他们答复说：“纳匝肋人耶稣。”他向他们说：“我就是”。出卖他的犹达斯也同他们站在一起。

text_en: When Jesus said to them, “I am he, ” they stepped back and fell to the ground.
text_cn: 耶稣一对他们说了“我就是”，他们便倒退跌在地上。

text_en: Again he asked them, “Whom are you looking for? ” And they said, “Jesus of Nazareth. ”
text_cn: 于是他又问他们说：“你们找谁？”他们说：“纳匝肋人耶稣。”

text_en: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. So if you are looking for me, let these men go. ”
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“我已给你们说了‘我就是’；你们既然找我，就让这些人去罢！”

text_en: This was to fulfill the word that he had spoken, “I did not lose a single one of those whom you gave me. ”
text_cn: 这是为应验他先前所说的话：“你赐给我的人，其中我没有丧失一个。”

text_en: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s slave, and cut off his right ear. The slave’s name was Malchus.
text_cn: 西满伯多禄有一把剑，就拔出来，向大司祭的一个仆人砍去，削下了他的右耳；那仆人名叫玛耳曷。

text_en: Jesus said to Peter, “Put your sword back into its sheath. Am I not to drink the cup that the Father has given me? ”
text_cn: 耶稣就对伯多禄说：“把剑收入鞘内！父赐给我的杯，我岂能不喝吗？”

text_en: So the soldiers, their officer, and the Jewish police arrested Jesus and bound him.
text_cn: 于是兵队、千夫长和犹太人的差役拘捕了耶稣，把他捆起来，

text_en: First they took him to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
text_cn: 先解送到亚纳斯那里，亚纳斯是那一年当大司祭的盖法的岳父。

text_en: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it was better to have one person die for the people.
text_cn: 就是这个盖法曾给犹太人出过主意：叫一个人替百姓死，是有利的。

text_en: Simon Peter and another disciple followed Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest,
text_cn: 那时，西满伯多禄同另一个门徒跟着耶稣；那门徒是大司祭所认识的，便同耶稣一起进了大司祭的庭院，

text_en: but Peter was standing outside at the gate. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out, spoke to the woman who guarded the gate, and brought Peter in.
text_cn: 伯多禄却站在门外；大司祭认识的那个门徒遂出来，对看门的侍女说了一声，就领伯多禄进去。

text_en: The woman said to Peter, “You are not also one of this man’s disciples, are you? ” He said, “I am not. ”
text_cn: 那看门的侍女对伯多禄说：“你不也是这人的一个门徒吗？”他说：“我不是。”

text_en: Now the slaves and the police had made a charcoal fire because it was cold, and they were standing around it and warming themselves. Peter also was standing with them and warming himself.
text_cn: 那时，仆人和差役，因为天冷就生了炭火，站着烤火取暖；伯多禄也同他们站在一起，烤火取暖。

text_en: Then the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
text_cn: 大司祭就有关他的门徒和他的教义审问耶稣。

text_en: Jesus answered, “I have spoken openly to the world; I have always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where all the Jews come together. I have said nothing in secret.
text_cn: 耶稣答复他说：“我向来公开地对世人讲话，我常常在会堂和圣殿内，即众犹太人所聚集的地方施教，在暗地里我并没有讲过什么。

text_en: Why do you ask me? Ask those who heard what I said to them; they know what I said. ”
text_cn: 你为什么问我？你问那些听过我的人，我给他们讲了什么；他们知道我所说的。”

text_en: When he had said this, one of the police standing nearby struck Jesus on the face, saying, “Is that how you answer the high priest? ”
text_cn: 他刚说完这话，侍立在旁的一个差役，就给了耶稣一个耳光，说：“你就这样答复大司祭吗？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “If I have spoken wrongly, testify to the wrong. But if I have spoken rightly, why do you strike me? ”
text_cn: 耶稣答复他说：“我若说得不对，你指证哪里不对；若对，你为什么打我？”

text_en: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
text_cn: 亚纳斯遂把被捆的耶稣，解送到大司祭盖法那里去。

text_en: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They asked him, “You are not also one of his disciples, are you? ” He denied it and said, “I am not. ”
text_cn: 西满伯多禄仍站着烤火取暖，于是有人向他说：“你不也是他门徒中的一个吗？”伯多禄否认说：“我不是。”

text_en: One of the slaves of the high priest, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Did I not see you in the garden with him? ”
text_cn: 有大司祭的一个仆役，是伯多禄削下耳朵的那人的亲戚，对他说：“我不是在山园中看见你同他在一起吗？”

text_en: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment the cock crowed.
text_cn: 伯多禄又否认了，立时鸡就叫了。

text_en: Then they took Jesus from Caiaphas to Pilate’s headquarters. It was early in the morning. They themselves did not enter the headquarters, so as to avoid ritual defilement and to be able to eat the Passover.
text_cn: 然后他们从盖法那里把耶稣解往总督府，那时是清晨；他们自己却没有进入总督府，怕受了沾污，而不能吃逾越节的羔羊。

text_en: So Pilate went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man? ”
text_cn: 因此，比拉多出来，到外面向他们说：“你们对这人提出什么控告？”

text_en: They answered, “If this man were not a criminal, we would not have handed him over to you. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“如果这人不是作恶的，我们便不会把他交给你。”

text_en: Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and judge him according to your law. ” The Jews replied, “We are not permitted to put anyone to death. ”
text_cn: 比拉多便对他们说：“你们自己把他带去，按照你们的法律审判他罢！”犹太人回答说：“我们是不许处死任何人的！”

text_en: (This was to fulfill what Jesus had said when he indicated the kind of death he was to die. )
text_cn: 这是为应验耶稣论及自己将怎样死去而说过的话。

text_en: Then Pilate entered the headquarters again, summoned Jesus, and asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews? ”
text_cn: 比拉多于是又进了总督府，叫了耶稣来，对他说：“你是犹太人的君王吗？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Do you ask this on your own, or did others tell you about me? ”
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“这话是你由自己说的，或是别人论我而对你说的？”

text_en: Pilate replied, “I am not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests have handed you over to me. What have you done? ”
text_cn: 比拉多答说：“莫非我是犹太人？你的民族和司祭长把你交付给我，你作了什么？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not from this world. If my kingdom were from this world, my followers would be fighting to keep me from being handed over to the Jews. But as it is, my kingdom is not from here. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我的国不属于这世界；假使我的国属于这世界，我的臣民早已反抗了，使我不至于被交给犹太人；但是，我的国不是这世界的。”

text_en: Pilate asked him, “So you are a king? ” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this I was born, and for this I came into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to my voice. ”
text_cn: 于是比拉多对他说：“那么，你就是君王了？”耶稣回答说：“你说的是，我是君王。我为此而生，我也为此而来到世界上，为给真理作证：凡属于真理的，必听从我的声音。”

text_en: Pilate asked him, “What is truth? ” After he had said this, he went out to the Jews again and told them, “I find no case against him.
text_cn: 比拉多遂说：“什么是真理？”说了这话，再出去到犹太人那里，向他们说：“我在这人身上查不出什么罪状来。

text_en: But you have a custom that I release someone for you at the Passover. Do you want me to release for you the King of the Jews? ”
text_cn: 你们有个惯例：在逾越节我该给你们释放一人；那么，你们愿意我给你们释放犹太人的君王吗？”

text_en: They shouted in reply, “Not this man, but Barabbas! ” Now Barabbas was a bandit.
text_cn: 他们就大声喊说：“不要这人，而要巴辣巴！”巴辣巴原是个强盗。
